rule.name: timeout-abandons-async-task
rule.message: {0}(...) on a CompletableFuture from supplyAsync or runAsync stops waiting, not the task: cancelling or completing a CompletableFuture never interrupts its task, so the task keeps running with its thread and side effects, and a retry overlaps it. Submit the work to an ExecutorService instead, wait with future.get(timeout, unit) and call cancel(true) on that Future when the TimeoutException arrives.
